claim.claim-text: a dielectric material layer (110) over a conductive land (120), wherein the dielectric material layer (110) comprises an opening extending through the dielectric material layer (110) to a portion of the conductive land (120); and a conductive connector, the conductive connector comprising: a conductive fill material (170) comprising ruthenium; and a second material (130) between the conductive fill material (170) and a sidewall of the opening of the dielectric material layer, wherein the second material (130) is made of titanium, tantalum, tungsten, molybdenum or nitrides thereof,
wherein the conductive land (120) is a part of a conductive route structure, wherein the conductive route structure is a back end metallization.
2. The microelectronic device structure of claim 1, wherein the second material (130) is in direct contact with both the dielectric material layer (110) and the conductive fill material (170).
3. The microelectronic device structure of one of the previous claims, wherein the ruthenium of the conductive fill material (170) has a thickness of between 1A and 1000A.

4. The microelectronic device structure of one of the previous claims, wherein the conductive connector is in direct contact with the conductive land (120), and wherein a portion of the second material (130) is between the conductive land (120) and the conductive fill material (170).

5. The microelectronic device structure of claim 4, wherein the second material (130) is in direct contact with the dielectric material layer (110), the conductive fill material (170), and the conductive land (120).
6. The microelectronic device structure of one of the previous claims, wherein the conductive land (120) comprises copper.
a board; and a microelectronic device structure according to one of the previous claims attached to the board.
